dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: #It's been a while, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I've grown quite a bit stronger. You ready for some sparring?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: ...Haha, kidding! You're here because there's something you want to say, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: It's the perfect place to make a home.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Charming, peaceful... and warm.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I'd love to bring Tonia, Anthon, and Teucer to stay here...

choices.text: I don't think this place can accommodate so many people...

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Hahaha, sorry, I didn't mean it like that.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: I just think that Tonia and the others would be very happy in your company.

choices.text: I'm not actually as good with kids as you think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Of course. I'm more than willing.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: In Snezhnaya, there's a kind of liquor called Fire-Water.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: If a friend will join you outside in the bitter cold to drink Fire-Water and chat together, you know they're the kind of person you want with you on the battlefield.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I would join you for just such a conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: And in the heat of battle, I know that you'd have my back.

choices.text: You're not afraid that I might backstab you?

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: This is the level of trust I place in you.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: If you joined me on my path to world domination, we would be unstoppable.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: What do you say? Do you accept my proposal?

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Hah, you lack conviction in your own abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Hmm... When can you spare a few weeks?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I want to take you to see the scenery of my homeland.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: To gaze upon the endless snowy sky, to stand on frozen lakes that won't shatter, no matter how hard you tread.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Some people even carve gigantic ice sculptures there.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: If you like snowball fights, I'll pair with you and we can face off against my siblings.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Oh, and I almost forgot! I can also make authentic Borsch for you with specialty ingredients from my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: ...And, of course, we have to go ice fishing! The fish are much larger than the ones you find in ponds.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: Mmm, seems like I'll have to give my family a heads-up.

response.speaker: Tartaglia
response.text: I can see it now, the beaming smiles on their faces as they gather around and read the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Tartaglia.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Good morning, comrade.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: If there's ever a battle that even you find a challenge, don't forget to call me.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I'd appreciate the... exercise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Tartaglia.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: It's already that time of the night, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Who knows when we'll meet next...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: A kitchen? Haha, how intriguing! You know, I used to cook quite often. Let me show you a thing or two!

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: The arts of cooking and war aren't so different. Tasting your opponent's dishes is also a form of battle.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I wonder... dare you accept my challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: Ah, such a rich aroma truly makes you feel refreshed and alive.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I've tasted dishes from both Liuli Pavilion and Xinyue Kiosk, but you can't fully appreciate a country's cuisines if you only stick to high-end restaurants.

dialogues.speaker: Tartaglia
dialogues.text: I leave it to you to bring me around and taste the local snacks and specialties, alright?
